{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galaxy Gladiator Federation''' was the governing body that controlled the underground world of arena [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] fighting. Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Federation was faced with opposition from a number of fronts, primarily because it lacked sufficient planning to handle the wide variety of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] abilities and disparate fighting styles found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

After the end of the Clone Wars, gladiator droid battles gained popularity, though many fans were only interested in the carnage.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
